known_limits: Ordinary reference images do not guarantee exact first/intermediate/last frames or the specified timestamps.
Padding improves input safety space but does not guarantee output framing or anatomical scale.
Static image acceptance does not establish input alignment, stable material color or actual video continuity.
Six-second source duration does not set gameplay death-animation duration.
